1. Vikram asal mein kis cheez ke liye message kar raha tha, aur uske pehle do messages ki kaunsi details yeh dikhati hain? Uske aakhri do replies ka kya matlab hai?
2. Aman se exactly kahan galti hui? Uske har move ko evaluate karo — alternatives, cousin ka example, "discipline" wali line, "dus darwaze" wali line.
3. Aman ko ab repair ke liye jo message bhejna chahiye, bilkul waisa likho jaisa use bhejna chahiye.

1. Vikram **UPSC/collector result** ke liye message kar raha tha — “list mein nahi hoon” aur “woh last attempt tha”. Pehle do messages dikhate hain ki **10 saal** barbaad hue, **papa ka retirement fund Delhi coaching** mein gaya, aur **poori gali “collector sahab”** bolke mazak udaa rahi hai. Uske aakhri do replies — *“haan. shayad.”* aur *“haan theek hai. chal baad mein baat karte hain”* — matlab woh **tut chuka hai, Aman ki baaton se convinced nahi, aur baat khatm karna chahta hai**.

2. Aman ki galti **har step pe emotional invalidate karna**:
- **State PCS / SSC CGL**: seedha “end nahi hai” bolke dard ko skip kiya.
- **Cousin (28, CAT, IIM Indore)**: false equivalence; UPSC failure ko CAT success se compare karna bekaar.
- **“Discipline/GK waste nahi”**: uske 10 saal ke loss ko “consolation prize” bana diya.
- **“Dus darwaze”**: cliché; uski humiliation aur financial loss ko ignore kiya.
Har move **solution de raha tha jabki Vikram ko sunne ki zaroorat thi**.

3. Repair message:
*"Vikram, sorry yaar. Main result sunke seedha solution dene laga, par woh galat tha. 10 saal, papa ka paise, aur gali ka mazak — yeh sab real dard hai, mujhe bas sunna chahiye tha. Koi advice nahi, jab tu baat karna chahe toh main hoon. Abhi bas tere saath hoon."*
